blocks.title: Graphical representation of software systems
blocks.text: Graphical representation of software systems uses visual diagrams to show aspects of a system's structure and behaviour. It simplifies complex systems so developers and stakeholders can understand, communicate about and manage them more easily.
Diagrams such as Unified Modeling Language (UML) diagrams are widely used to show the components of software, their relationships and their interactions.
